axis.worker.url.markdownDescription: AXIS Worker origin for live ticket mint (`GET /api/ws/live?issue=ticket`) and WS upgrade (`/api/ws/live?ticket=`). Loopback and known AXIS Worker hosts are allowed; other remotes require `#axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint#`. **Application (user) scope only** — workspace settings cannot redirect the mint origin that receives the `pn_` Worker key. Never put `pn_` keys in settings — use SecretStorage.

axis.live.enabled.markdownDescription: When false, `axis.liveStart` is a no-op and the live StatusBar stays off.
